logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the synthesized complexes was assessed by measuring their partitioncoefficients (log Po/w) between n-octanol (o) and water (w) using the shake-flask method [10].A calibration curve for each complex was established by recording the absorbance at varyingconcentrations in the aqueous phase. After determining the initial concentration, equal volumesof the aqueous solution and n-octanol were combined and vortexed to ensure thorough mixing.Once the phases separated, the concentration of the complex remaining in the aqueous layerwas measured using the calibration curve. The partition coefficient was then calculated usingthe formula log Po/w = log [C]o/[C]w, where [C]o represents the complex concentration in the n-octanol phase and [C]w represents its concentration in the aqueous phase.
